title: 2003 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: Fourteen white cubes are put together to form the figure on the right. The complete surface of the figure, including the bottom, is painted red. The figure is then separated into individual cubes. How many of the individual cubes have exactly four red faces?

solutions.text:
A cube has exactly four painted faces exactly when it is attached to exactly two other cubes.

The \(4\) top cubes touch only one other cube, so they have \(5\) painted faces. The \(4\) bottom corner cubes touch three other cubes, so they have \(3\) painted faces.

The remaining \(14-4-4=6\) cubes each touch exactly two other cubes, so they have exactly four painted faces.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: A cube has four painted faces exactly when it touches two other cubes.
Separate the top cubes, bottom corner cubes, and remaining cubes.
